title: Ethiopia is undergoing significant economic changes, particularly in agriculture, as it shifts from a rigid Marxist-Leninist system to a more market-oriented economy. A new agricultural scheme in the Harerghe province aims to help small farmers by streamlining access to financial credit, allowing them to purchase essential farming tools like oxen. This initiative, supported by the UN's International Fund for Agricultural Development (Ifad), has already enabled many farmers to increase their crop yields and improve their livelihoods. The program also includes efforts to enhance drought resistance through irrigation and health facilities. As the country moves towards a mixed economy, experts are hopeful that these changes will help mitigate the impacts of an impending drought.
